headline: We've built it into AG2 natively, so a decision agent looks like any other agent.

media.alt: Image from the post by AG2

text:
AG2 1.1.0 adds support for a different kind of model, TypeSafe's Jev.

Jev doesn't do your typical text generation. You send it state and a question, and it answers: yes or no, which option, what score. TypeSafe calls it a System One model which means fast, structured judgment of…
